rationale: Sean is building Fusion Reality around direct manipulation interfaces for AR/smart glasses powered by AI, while Qianhua leads product at CollovLabs in the consumer-AI space—both working at the intersection of AI and user-facing systems. Sean's conviction that spatial computing should move beyond voice interaction aligns with the product-focused thinking needed to scale consumer AI applications, and Qianhua's product leadership could complement Sean's technical depth in WebXR and mixed reality as Fusion Reality grows.
intro_message: Xiaoan (Sean) Liu, meet Qianhua Ge — you're both building in consumer AI, and Sean's work on AI-driven spatial computing and smart glasses interfaces could benefit from Qianhua's product perspective at CollovLabs.
